resources.string: Keeps you out of the Instagram Reels feed.

InstaFocus reads the names of on-screen views inside the Instagram app (for example \"reel viewer\" or \"Reels tab\") to notice when Reels open, covers the Reels tab button, and taps Home or Back for you. From other apps it only notices that a window changed, to know you left Instagram. It does not read messages, captions or usernames, and nothing is stored or sent anywhere: the app has no internet permission.
The accessibility service is not enabled. Open Accessibility settings and turn on InstaFocus.
The service is enabled but not connected. Toggle it off and on again, and set InstaFocus to Never sleeping in battery settings.
The Reels feed is blocked in Instagram.
The service is running but Block Reels is off.
A reel someone sends you plays; swiping to the next one closes it. Off: shared reels close right away. Reels from the feed or a profile always play once; reels from Explore are always closed.

If the InstaFocus switch is greyed out in Accessibility settings, Android has restricted it because the app was not installed from a store. Open App info, tap the three-dot menu at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, confirm, then go back and enable the service.
Samsung phones may stop the service in the background. In Settings > Battery > Background usage limits, add InstaFocus to Never sleeping apps (or open App info > Battery and choose Unrestricted).

InstaFocus looks at Instagram\'s view ids, not at what is on the screen. It covers the Reels tab button with a patch in the tab bar\'s colour, and if the Reels tab opens anyway it taps Home. A reel shared in a DM, or opened from the feed or a profile, plays once; swiping to the next reel closes it. Reels opened from Explore or search close right away. It reacts after the viewer appears, so a frame of a reel may flash. It depends on Instagram\'s internal names and layout, so an Instagram update can break it until the rules are updated. It never acts when it is unsure, so it will rather miss a reel than block a chat.
Keeps the ids of the views on screen in the last scan, in memory only. No text, names or messages.
No entries yet. Open Instagram with the service running.
